Manage kubernetes secrets

Perform static analysis of user workloads and container images (e.g. Kubesec, KubeLinter)

Ensure immutability of containers at runtime

rules.action: archive the topic directory; redirect its links
rules.rule: its objective is not in the new syllabus (removed, or below MATCH similarity to every new one)

rules.action: one PR through the whole content process (content, exercises, lab, translations)
rules.rule: its objective changed: best match has MATCH (0.6) <= similarity < REWORD (0.9)

rules.action: re-run every check against the new text; record the result in meta.yaml; a failed check makes it regenerate
rules.rule: its objective was reworded (REWORD <= similarity < 1), moved to another domain, or its domain's published weight changed

rules.action: no content change; only its listed technical version lines may be rewritten in place, by the version bump
rules.rule: its objective text, domain and domain weight are identical

rules.action: a new topic directory, through the whole content process
rules.rule: an objective of the new syllabus that no topic covers
